articles.summary: SAN FRANCISCO --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 6, 2026-- Antom, Ant International's global merchant payment and digitisation platform, is bringing Affirm (NASDAQ: AFRM) to its merchants in the US, giving them a simple way to offer US customers a pay-over-time option those customers already know and trust.
articles.title: Affirm partners with Ant International's Antom to bring pay-over-time to US customers

articles.summary: SAN FRANCISCO --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 5, 2026-- Affirm Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: AFRM) today announced it will publish its first quarter fiscal year 2027 shareholder letter, including its financial results, on its investor relations website at https://investors.affirm.com/ on Thursday, November 5,
articles.title: Affirm to announce first quarter fiscal year 2027 results on November 5, 2026
